task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel XRD benchmark chart, variant 09. Scenario: noisy low-intensity pattern.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel XRD pattern benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

x.visible_pattern: Major ticks labeled 10 through 80 are evenly spaced across the bottom axis.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0003; the log10 candidate had much larger error.

y.visible_pattern: Major ticks labeled 0 through 250 are evenly spaced up the left axis.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0007; log10 is incompatible because the visible y-axis includes 0.

unresolved_ambiguities: No printed subpanel label is visible in the image; the target panel was identified as the only panel in this single-panel figure.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: Single main-plot trace is fully visible; no overlap-induced hidden segments were identified.
response.interpretation_notes: Single black XRD pattern with no legend or inset. Points follow the visual centerline of the thick noisy stroke across the full plot width.
unresolved_ambiguities: The rendered trace appears as a broad noisy band, so the sampled path follows the band centerline rather than a razor-thin stroke.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
